title: Senior Manager, Quality & QMS
text:
**Job Overview:**

The Senior Manager, Quality & QMS is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for Intech’s medical device manufacturing operations.

This position provides senior-level leadership for all site quality activities, including production quality, nonconformance management, CAPA, internal and external audits, supplier quality, document and record control, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. A primary responsibility of the role will be to lead the organization in developing and implementing an effective QMS and preparing the site for ISO 9001 certification.

This position will serve as the primary quality leader for the site and will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, and other functional leaders to ensure that quality is integrated into the business and manufacturing processes rather than operating as a separate inspection function. This role is a hands-on position and will operate strategically while also working directly with manufacturing personnel to establish practical, sustainable quality processes.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System.
* Lead the organization through its ISO 9001 readiness and certification process.
* Establish and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and other QMS documentation.
* Establish effective document and record control processes.
* Develop quality objectives, metrics, and management-review processes.
* Ensure QMS processes are understood, implemented, and effective across the organization.
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement and develop practical plans to address them.
* Provide leadership for quality throughout the manufacturing process.
* Establish appropriate inspection, testing, sampling, and process-control requirements.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify and eliminate sources of variation and defects.
* Monitor production quality performance and trends.
* Lead efforts to reduce scrap, rework, defects, and recurring quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for nonconforming product(s), product identification, traceability, and inspection status.
* Support process changes, equipment changes, product introductions, and manufacturing improvements from a quality perspective.
* Own and continuously improve the site's CAPA and nonconformance processes.
* Lead investigations into significant quality issues and recurring nonconformances.
* Establish effective root-cause analysis and corrective-action practices.
* Ensure corrective actions address systemic causes and are implemented and verified for effectiveness.
* Monitor CAPA and NCR trends to identify broader process and systemic issues.
* Establish appropriate escalation of significant quality risks to site leadership.
* Develop and manage the internal audit program.
* Conduct or oversee internal QMS and process audits.
* Coordinate customer, certification, surveillance, and other external audits.
* Serve as the primary quality contact during external audits.
* Ensure audit findings are appropriately investigated, corrected, and closed.
* Build an organization that is continuously audit-ready rather than preparing only immediately before an audit.
* Establish and maintain supplier quality processes.
* Develop supplier qualification, evaluation, monitoring, and re-evaluation practices.
* Establish supplier quality expectations in partnership with Supply Chain and Operations.
* Monitor supplier quality performance and trends.
* Lead or support supplier corrective actions.
* Participate in supplier selection and qualification activities as appropriate.
* Address recurring supplier issues through effective root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Establish meaningful quality metrics and dashboards.
* Monitor trends in NCRs, CAPAs, audits, supplier performance, scrap, rework, customer issues, and other relevant indicators.
* Translate quality data into actionable improvement initiatives.
* Provide regular quality performance updates to leadership.
* Use structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve processes and reduce risk.
* Develop strong working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization.
* Partner closely with manufacturing personnel to solve problems at the source.
* Provide quality leadership, coaching, and training.
* Establish clear expectations for quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Promote a culture of prevention, accountability, disciplined problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate quality risks clearly and objectively to leadership.

*Management reserves the right to change job duties and responsibilities at any time. Therefore, this job description is not designed to cover every requirement of the job.*

**Education and Work Experience Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in quality, quality systems, manufacturing quality, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, managing, or significantly improving a Quality Management System.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001.
* Must have demonstrated experience taking an organization through ISO 9001 certification.
* Demonstrated experience with CAPA, nonconformance management, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience with supplier quality and supplier corrective actions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both production personnel and senior leadership.
* Ability to establish structure and processes in an environment where the QMS is still developing.
* Medical device manufacturing experience preferred.
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor training/certification preferred.
* ASQ certification such as CQA, CQE, or CMQ/OE.
* Experience with statistical process control, process capability, risk management, or other quality engineering tools.
* Lean Six Sigma or other continuous-improvement experience a plus.
* Familiarity with applicable medical-device quality and regulatory requirements a plus

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with company policies
* Must occasionally lift, carry and/or move up to 25 lbs.
* Occasionally required to stand, walk, bend, and constantly sit for extended periods
* Must be able to talk, listen and speak clearly on the telephone
* Continually required to read, write, and type
* Occasional exposure to heat or cold (non-weather) environments
* Occasionally required to use hand/arm movements such as grasping, reaching, pulling
